SOCIAL STUDIES — TERMLY EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Climatic regions in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Climatic regions in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Climatic regions in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   C. Explain Climatic regions in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Climatic regions in Eastern Africa.

2. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Littering in markets
   D. Destroying road signs

3. Which statement about Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   B. Skip evidence when discussing Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa.
   C. Say Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa as rumours only.

   A. Explain School and Community with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

   D. Treat School and Community as rumours only.

7. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Name the president
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

8. Which statement about Beef Farming is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Beef Farming as rumours only.
   B. Explain Beef Farming with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Beef Farming never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Beef Farming.

9. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Avoid saving forever

10. Which statement about Culture and Social Organisation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Culture and Social Organisation.
   B. Say Culture and Social Organisation never happens in Kenya.

12. Which statement about Population distribution in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   B. Say Population distribution in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Population distribution in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Population distribution in Eastern Africa as rumours only.

13. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Nakuru
   C. Nairobi
   D. Mombasa

14. Which statement about Main physical features in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Main physical features in Eastern Africa.

   D. Skip evidence when discussing Language groups in Eastern Africa.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Culture and Social Organisation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain School and Community and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Beef Farming and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
